value.rationale: The second Cantor stage is a natural four-point test of the finite Fourier D-optimal design invariant. Existing full-depth digit-tower determinant formulas do not settle optimality among all frequency sets. Exhaustive sharp unrestricted volume and equality classes reveal a strict failure of the hereditary digit-tower optimum, while complete zero and nonzero magnitude strata characterize stability-by-volume of every four-character sampling choice. This is a motivated complete natural cutoff, not an arbitrary sparse numerical slice.
